title: HandshakeRequest
description: The message an agent sends to a service before performing an action. Includes the agent's identity, the requested capability, the delegation chain proving authority, and a nonce for replay protection. See spec §8.2, §9.

aud.description: Receiving service's DID — MUST be verified by the receiver. See spec §6.7.

nonce.description: Cryptographically random value, ≥128 bits. Receiver MUST track and reject duplicates within TTL window.

deployer.description: Organization responsible for this agent's deployment

model.description: Identifier of the underlying model. Example: claude-sonnet-4-5

model_version.description: OPTIONAL. Specific model version or revision.

instance_id.description: Implementation-defined unique identifier for this agent instance / session

code_hash.description: OPTIONAL. Hash of the agent code or build artifact, for supply-chain attestation.

agent_attestation.description: Verifiable claims about the agent making the request

capability.description: The capability being requested for this action

delegation_chain.description: Ordered root → leaf chain of DelegationTokens proving authority

signature.description: Signature over the JCS-canonicalized form of this object with the signature field omitted. Signed by the agent's key. See spec §6.3.
